general_rov_settings_page_description: Generic settings for the Manafish ROV.
general_rov_settings_firmware_version_de: Current version of the Manafish ROV firmware.
general_rov_settings_microcontroller_fir: Select and flash the firmware with the specified output protocol for the pico. DSHOT is a modern digital protocol that supports bi-directional communication, allowing reading of thruster RPM, voltage, current and temperature. However, it can be more sensitive to noise and may introduce higher latency if the ESCs are not powerful enough. PWM is the older analog protocol and does not support feedback, but it is generally more robust. It is recommended to use DSHOT first, and switch to PWM only if you encounter issues.
general_rov_settings_fluid_type_descript: Set correct fluid type to get accurate depth readings. This is neccesary because saltwater and freshwater have slightly different density.
general_rov_settings_smoothing_factor_de: How much smoothing applied to the movement of the ROV. Smoothing can be nice for getting smooth movement and camera shots, but it can also make the ROV feel less responsive. 0 leads to no smoothing. If the smoothing factor is 1, it will take 1 second for the thrusters to go from 0% power to 100% power. It is reccomended to keep this setting at 0 if using a gamepad or other type of controller with joysticks.
calibration_page_description: Calibrate the thrusters of the ROV.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_descripti:
Use this table to configure each thruster connected to your ROV. For each pin:
1. Click the test motor button.
2. Look at your thruster chart and see what number you assigned to the motor that is now spinning. Put this number in the 'Identifier' column.
3. Use your finger to feel if the motor is spinning clockwise or counterclockwise (when 'seen from above'). If the motor spins the same way as shown in your thruster chart, set 'Spin direction' to 'Normal'. If not, set 'Spin direction' to 'Reversed'.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_pin_toolt: The general purpose pin on the microcontroller that the thruster is connected to.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_identifie: The number shown next to the thruster on the thruster chart.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_spin_dire: What direction the motor spins by default when pressing test button.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_test_tool: Spins the thruster slowly in the specified direction on the specified pin.
calibration_thruster_pin_setup_rpm_toolt: The revolutions per minute of the thruster.
calibration_thruster_allocation_descript: Use this matrix to control how each thruster responds to different movement input. Each row of the thrust allocation matrix represents one way the drone could move or turn. Fill in the numbers in the row to indicate what thrusters need to activate for the Manafish to move/rotate in that direction. Positive values produce forward thrust, negative values produce reverse thrust, and 0 disables the thruster for that input.
calibration_thruster_allocation_identifi: The number shown next to the thruster on the thruster chart.
calibration_thruster_allocation_surge_to: Thrusters to activate to move forward
calibration_thruster_allocation_sway_too: Thrusters to activate to move right
calibration_thruster_allocation_heave_to: Thrusters to activate to move down (deeper)
calibration_thruster_allocation_pitch_to: Thrusters to activate to pitch up (nose up)
calibration_thruster_allocation_yaw_tool: Thrusters to activate to yaw right (nose right)
calibration_thruster_allocation_roll_too: Thrusters to activate to roll right (left side lifted)
calibration_thruster_allocation_action_1: Thrusters to activate for action 1 (custom or auxiliary function).
calibration_thruster_allocation_action_2: Thrusters to activate for action 2 (custom or auxiliary function).
regulator_page_description: PID-regulator settings for Manafish, responsible for auto-stabilization and depth hold.
regulator_pid_turn_speed_description: The speed of which the desired attitude changes in degrees per second. Higher rates will make the Manafish turn faster when auto-stabilization is enabled. Too high rates can cause unpredictable turning movement, as the Manafish will not be able to turn fast enough to keep up with the desired attitude.
regulator_pid_roll_description: Rotation around the axis passing from the middle of the front cap to rear cap.
regulator_pid_run_auto_tuning: Run Auto Tuning (DOES NOT WORK YET)
regulator_direction_coefficients_descrip: These coefficients should describe how quickly Manafish is able to move in the different directions. The ratios between these values determine how much each thruster will activate when using depth hold to move in the expected direction without drifting. Units don't matter as long as all axes use the same units.
power_page_description: Configure your Manafish power and battery settings.
power_thrusters_limit_description: The percentage of power given to the thrusters when you tell the Manafish to move. Higher values will make the Manafish move faster, but if the values are too hight you risk the Manafish overheating and turning off. 30% is a safe value, all above 50% is a bit risky.
power_actions_limit_description: The percentage of power given to motorized attachments activated by the action buttons. If you have no motorized attachments, this value changes nothing.
power_regulator_limit_description: The max percentage of power the regulator is able to give to the thrusters to keep the ROV stabilized. Higher values will allow the regulator to turn the Manfish quicker, but you rish overheating.
power_min_battery_voltage_description: The voltage of the battery when it is fully depleted. This will show as 0% battery in the app. Leave at default value unless you change to another type of battery.
power_max_battery_voltage_description: The voltage of the battery when it is fully charged. This will show as 100% battery in the app. Leave at default value unless you change to another type of battery.
keyboard_page_description:
Configure your keyboard bindings for controlling the Manafish with your keyboard. How to set new keybinds: 
1. Make sure no keys are being held down. 
2. Press the 'Set Keybid' button for the input you want to set a key bind for. 
3. Press the key you want to bind and HOLD IT PRESSED DOWN FOR AT LEAST 1 SECOND. 
If the key bind has been set correctly, the green bar under the input field should fill with green when the binded key is pressed.
gamepad_page_description:
Configure your gamepad or FPV controller bindings. How to set up key binds for your controller: 
1. Make sure all joysticks, buttons and switches are in their 'Neutral' position. 
2. Press the 'Set Keybid' button for the input you want to set a key bind for. 
3. Move the joystick/switch/button you want to bind to the position you want it to be in for the input field you are setting to receive a max value, and HOLD IT THERE FOR AT LEAST 1 SECOND. 
If the key bind has been set correctly, the green bar under the input field should fill and empty based on the joystic/switch/button you binded. The key binds will be saved, so the next time you connect the same controller you do not have to configure them again. 
Example: If we want the Manafish to surge backwards when the left joystick is moved down, we need to do the following: 1. Put the left joystick in a neutral position. 2. Press the 'Set Keybind' button for 'Negative Surge' (because we want to set the key bind that makes the Manafish surge backwards). 3. Push the left joysstick all the way down and hold it there for at least one second.

thruster_preset_default_movement_descrip: Thruster allocation preset that works for the 'generative' and 'default movement' thruster configurations. For this to work, you NEED to follow use the thruster chart from the assembly guide when doing the thruster pin and spin direction calibration.
thruster_preset_default_stability_descri: Thruster allocation preset that works for the 'default stability' thruster configuration. For this to work, you NEED to follow use the thruster chart from the assembly guide when doing the thruster pin and spin direction calibration.
thruster_preset_speedy_description: Thruster allocation preset that works for the 'speedy' thruster configuration. For this to work, you NEED to follow use the thruster chart from the assembly guide when doing the thruster pin and spin direction calibration.
thruster_preset_speedy_w_actions_descrip: Thruster allocation preset that works for the 'speedy' thruster configuration with two motorized attachments on identifier 7 and 8. For this to work, you NEED to follow use the thruster chart from the assembly guide when doing the thruster pin and spin direction calibration, and the motorized attachments need to be connected to the pins assigned to identifier 7 and 8 in the thruster pin calibration.
